files.plant_safety_protocols.txt:
BOTANICAL RESEARCH SAFETY GUIDELINES

1. Always wear protective equipment when handling unknown plant materials
2. Work in well-ventilated areas when processing plant specimens
3. Document all extraction procedures and chemical analyses
4. Store plant materials according to toxicity classifications
5. Report any adverse reactions immediately to safety coordinator

- Alkaloid-containing species (e.g., Taxus, Aconitum, Ricinus)
- Plants with cardiac glycosides
- Species with volatile toxic compounds
